engineering_use: The paired published operating points demonstrate the same governing conflict encoded by the project oracle: an operating point may satisfy recovery or CO while failing their conjunction. The present model places its worst case inside that joint pass region and therefore makes a stronger, explicitly testable prediction than bulk-purity reporting.
claim_boundary: The Bang CMR was experimentally operated with H2 sweep and a CO/H2/CO2/steam feed, but the public record used here does not establish the complete integrated four-bed PSA output as an independently measured dataset. It did not report N2 or CH4 product concentrations, and the two published points do not show a simultaneous pass of the present CO and recovery gates. The points validate the engineering tradeoff and one component-specific low-CO capability at the integrated-study level, not the final five-component apparatus or its joint pass claim.
